title: GTA VI Global Price Index
description:
What Grand Theft Auto VI costs in 63 markets: the official Standard and Ultimate Edition prices from the PlayStation Store and the Xbox Store (103 listings), converted to US dollars at official reference exchange rates and set against average pay (ILO) and income (World Bank). Prices collected 2026-11-11; exchange rates of 2026-11-10.

Live table, methodology and caveats: https://leonidalab.com/data/price-index/

Findings (Standard Edition; one figure per country: what the buyer pays at its cheaper store)

  • Cheapest: Japan $61.96, India $63.87, South Korea $67.06
  • Most expensive: Israel $100.75, Norway $100.25, Hungary $98.83
  • Hardest to afford (share of an average month's pay, ILO): Indonesia at least 36.5%, India 25.1%, Colombia 19.1%
  • Biggest difference between the two stores in one country: Colombia, $103.95 on Xbox against $95.19 on PlayStation

Files

  • gta6-price-index.csv: one row per market and store (103 rows)
  • gta6-price-index.json: the same rows plus every exchange rate used (value, source, date) and column definitions

Method

  • Prices are read directly from each market's official store. Each PlayStation price is checked twice (machine value against displayed price), and every storefront is confirmed to be the real country store.
  • Exchange rates: ECB euro reference rates, plus the issuing central bank or official source where the ECB publishes none (Argentina, Colombia, Chile, Ukraine, Taiwan; Saudi and UAE pegs). Nothing is estimated; where no official rate was available the USD fields are blank.
  • Taxes: each listing is marked for whether its price includes consumer tax (included / excluded / unverified), with an evidence link. Compare like with like, or use the *_final columns.
  • Pay: ILO average monthly earnings of employees (US$ series), 2021 or later only. National sources differ (mean vs median, coverage), so treat as indicative.

Unofficial. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games, Take-Two Interactive, Sony Interactive Entertainment or Microsoft. No game assets are included. ILO and World Bank inputs are CC BY 4.0.
notes: Pre-launch list prices; stores can change them. Each version of this dataset is a dated snapshot.
